question: In which of the following states in India is the largest mass nesting site for the Olive-ridley Turtles found ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The scientific name of the** Olive-ridley Turtle** is **'Lepidochelys olivacea'.**
 
• Lakhs of** endangered Olive Ridley turtles **flocked the **Rushikulya river **mouth for their annual** mass nesting **in **Odisha's Ganjam district**.
